matchingNote: Every markPassed operation carries requiredEvidenceAny. A show name alone does not prove whose show it is, so each candidate must ALSO carry the organizer or town in a STRUCTURED field: location or organizer. Notes are deliberately not searched, because prose negates -- a note reading 'nothing to do with The Rustic Fox' would satisfy a substring test as well as one reading 'run by The Rustic Fox'. A record whose name matches but whose location/organizer does not identify it is excluded and reported by name in the preview.

correctionNote: v2 used markPassed, which only ever MATCHES an existing record. Against the real board that returned UNMATCHED and skipped, leaving no Party on the Pavement record at all - neither active nor in Passed / Not Doing history. v3 uses upsertShow so the record is created if absent and updated in place if present, carrying the passed fields directly. Factual fields come from the app's own pop_racine_20260818 seed. Two deliberate departures from that seed are listed in seedDepartures.
seedDepartures: showExpenses omitted. The seed carries a projected $4 ramp-parking expense. calcYTD adds a non-completed show's showExpenses to YTD spend regardless of passed state (measured: $4), so including it would put money we will never spend into the P&L for a show we are not attending. The parking facts stay verbatim in notes.

Per-day openTime/closeTime not set - a package's show object cannot reach into days[]. Verified equivalent: dayCallClose() falls back to show-level openTime/closeTime, and a created record reports identical hours (call 11 AM, open 12 PM, close 7 PM) and identical showHours (8) to the seeded record.
